settings.intro: These settings update your DeCave Overview only. They do not start a broadcast or verify the creator's identity. Live status expires automatically.

settings.autoLiveHint: Needs a Twitch channel link above. Hub bots can announce it with the "Stream goes live" trigger.
settings.clipsOn: On: post new clips in the clips forum
settings.clipsHint: Checked every hour. Clips go to the forum room with "clip" in its name; members react to pick Clip of the week (Mondays).

privacy.heading: Your privacy here
privacy.body: This Hub is private for everyone. Members can't see who else is here, and only the DeCave team can post. Report anything that breaks the rules by right-clicking a message or profile.

about.title: About DeCave
about.body: DeCave is a home for the people you play with: Hubs with text, voice and forum rooms, friends and DMs, Squad Finder, events and screen sharing on web, Windows and Mac. It is built by a small independent team and shaped by the people using it.
about.alphaNote: DeCave is an alpha, not a finished release. Expect rough edges, frequent updates and the occasional reset of experimental features. Your feedback decides what we fix next.

adults.title: DeCave is now for adults 18+
adults.body: Accounts are now for people aged 18 and over. If you confirmed an age under 18 earlier, you'll be asked to confirm your birth date again.

release128.title: Release 0.1.128: one voice dock and clearer streams
release128.body: Voice controls now live in one place, the Hub sidebar dock. Muting someone's stream no longer silences their voice, and iOS gained a speaker toggle and screen broadcast.

welcome.title: Welcome to the DeCave alpha
welcome.body: Thanks for joining early. Read #rules, check #faq, and use Feedback in the left rail to tell us what's broken or missing.

shipped.title: A home for the whole session
shipped.body: Hubs, voice and screen sharing, friends and DMs, Squad Finder, Discover, events and the desktop apps.

inProgress.title: Desktop polish and trust
inProgress.body: Windows code signing, steadier voice and screen sharing, reliability and safety fixes.

next.title: Mobile up to date
next.body: Fresh Android and iOS builds on the same path as desktop.

later.title: Bigger rooms
later.body: A media-server path for larger voice and screen-share rooms.
